Academic Exchange Service - Scholarships for Graduate Studies The goal of this program is to offer students the opportunity to earn a master's degree abroad and gain international study experience. Students should be able to pursue their individual study interests and develop in the best possible way, both professionally and personally. More information Location Germany Scholarship Deadline October 1 Recurs Annually Degree levels Graduate - Master's Duration of Award Two years Maximum amount of award $ 33,600 plus travel allowance and insurance benefits. Restricted to these majors All majors are eligible to apply.
